title: Cloud runs lost per-tick board events: the wave loop was the only producer of task-started/task-completed
body: tickCollectedFeedEvent/tickDispatchedFeedEvent were emitted only by the deleted wave batches, so a cloud run's board feed now carries the run's own lifecycle events and nothing per tick - an operator watching a run cannot see which ticks its run-epic dispatched or what each verdict was. The door's dispatch (or the container's run-epic) needs a producer for per-tick run_events; the builders still exist in run-events.ts/run-feed.ts with no caller.
